summary.content:
Today's selection covers 70 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 44 on Artificial Intelligence and 12 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: OpenAI acquires presentation startup NextSlide
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Planned Amazon data center could become the biggest climate polluter in the U.S.
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights phishing, data breaches, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from TechCrunch, The Verge, BBC Technology, SecurityWeek, Krebs on Security and others
• **Fresh Content**: 7 articles published in the last 24 hours
